# pve_cluster_join_info (Data Source)

Join information a peer node needs (fingerprint, ticket, allowed IPs/links).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_cluster_join_info" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) The node for which the joinee gets the nodeinfo.  (default: current connected node)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `join_info` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--join_info))

### Nested Schema for `join_info`

Read-Only:

- `config_digest` (String)
- `nodelist` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--join_info--nodelist))
- `preferred_node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `totem` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--join_info--totem))

<a id="nestedatt--join_info--nodelist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `join_info.nodelist`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The cluster node name.
- `nodeid` (Number) Node id for this node.
- `pve_addr` (String)
- `pve_fp` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `quorum_votes` (Number)
- `ring0_addr` (String) Address and priority information of a single corosync link. (up to 8 links supported; link0..link7)
